greeting: Good morning, Zuhair. Hope your Thursday starts gently, with a good coffee and a quiet moment before the day picks up.

lead.headline: Democrats win control of both chambers of Congress in US midterms
lead.summary: Projections show Democrats flipping the Senate and taking the House, the first time in 20 years a Republican president has lost both chambers. Many races were still being counted, so final seat totals may shift.

stories.headline: An AI-native lab that runs DNA experiments on its own
stories.summary: Published in Nature, this paper presents AutoDNA, a laboratory where AI agents plan and carry out molecular-biology experiments across more than 20 types of instruments with little human involvement. Nature ran a companion News & Views and a news story the same day, a sign of the attention it is drawing.

stories.headline: Google faces backlash over turning off Search for schools that restrict AI
stories.summary: A Google plan that would switch off Search for schools that don't opt in to its AI tools drew criticism from politicians. Google has since said its AI tools are off by default and schools can turn them back on.

stories.headline: Anthropic is working on a way to prove which AI model made an output
stories.summary: The company is developing an open-source system meant to verify the identity of the model behind a piece of AI output. There are no plans yet to deploy it at any lab.

stories.headline: Melbourne Cup crowd brightened by frocks and Robbie Williams under grey skies
stories.summary: Racegoers at Flemington turned out in colourful fashion despite a wet, grey start to Cup day, with Robbie Williams set to perform.

stories.headline: Car splits in half and bursts into flames in fatal Keysborough crash
stories.summary: A car hit a pole on Cheltenham Road just before 1am and burst into flames, and a person died. Two other men were injured and detectives are looking into reports it was speeding.

stories.headline: World reacts to Democrats' sweeping midterm victory
stories.summary: Foreign leaders and media are weighing what the result means for Ukraine and for Trump's governing style. Germany's chancellor expects little to change.

stories.headline: Trump says US will stop giving Israel aid after year-end
stories.summary: Trump announced Washington will no longer fund Israel after the end of this year. He expects military assistance to be phased out during 2027.

thought: Small steps, taken every day, still add up to a long way.
